description.short_caption: CT of the right shoulder showing prosthesis and surrounding abnormalities.
description.detailed_description: This CT image of the right shoulder demonstrates a prosthetic humeral component in place. There is evidence of peri-prosthetic lucency, suggesting possible loosening or infection. Surrounding soft tissue changes are visible, which may indicate inflammation or infection. The image is presented in a coronal plane with good contrast resolution.
visible_findings: soft tissue changes around the prosthesis

description.short_caption: CT of the right shoulder showing soft tissue swelling and possible abscess formation.
description.detailed_description: This CT image of the right shoulder demonstrates a coronal view with notable soft tissue swelling and hypodense areas suggestive of fluid collection, consistent with abscess formation. The humeral head and surrounding structures are visible, with arrows pointing to areas of abnormality. There is no obvious bony destruction, but the findings suggest an infectious or inflammatory process.
visible_findings: soft tissue swelling around the shoulder
hypodense areas consistent with fluid collection
no clear evidence of bony destruction

description.short_caption: Gram stain showing intracellular Gram-negative diplococci.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of an aspirate. Numerous neutrophils are visible, characterized by their multilobed nuclei. Within some of these neutrophils, small Gram-negative diplococci are evident, appearing as paired red-staining cocci. The background is lightly stained, with no significant extracellular organisms visible.

Case_08002/figure4.jpg.source_caption: Gram stain of aspirate with organisms (arrows).

description.short_caption: Gram stain of aspirate showing organisms (arrows).
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of an aspirate specimen. Numerous neutrophils are visible, characterized by their multi-lobed nuclei and pink cytoplasm. In the center of the field, there are small, round, Gram-positive cocci arranged in clusters, indicated by arrows. The background appears lightly stained, consistent with extracellular material.

description.short_caption: Blood agar plate showing bacterial colonies.
description.detailed_description: The image shows a blood agar plate with bacterial colonies growing in streaked patterns. The colonies are small, round, and appear to be white or light-colored against the red background of the agar. The streaking pattern suggests an attempt to isolate individual colonies. The blood agar medium is commonly used to culture and identify bacterial pathogens.

description.short_caption: Gram stain showing gram-positive cocci in clusters.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of bacterial culture growth. Numerous gram-positive cocci are visible, arranged predominantly in clusters. The organisms are stained purple, consistent with their gram-positive nature, against a clear background. The clustering pattern suggests a morphology typical of staphylococci.
